claims.text: A UT San Antonio research project aims to turn language into data that could help clinicians understand and treat cognitive and communication difficulties.
claims.quote: A new collaborative research project is bringing together researchers from The University of Texas at San Antonio with expertise in speech-language pathology, artificial intelligence and veteran care and rehabilitation to turn language into data that could help clinicians better understand, and ultimately treat, cognitive and communication difficulties.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: The project received a $200,000 grant from the San Antonio Medical Foundation.
claims.quote: Alicia Swan, PhD, Vivian Ta-Johnson, PhD, and Rocio Norman, PhD, CCC-SLP, received a $200,000 collaborative grant from the San Antonio Medical Foundation.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: It is a one year proof of concept study. It uses natural language processing to measure speech and language features linked to mild brain injury.
claims.quote: The one-year, proof-of-concept study will use natural language processing, a form of artificial intelligence, to analyze and measure speech and language patterns associated with mTBI, with the intention of creating a tool that would make language analysis practical during a routine clinic visit.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: One of the three leads is Alicia Swan, director of rehabilitation research at the South Texas Veterans Health Care System.
claims.quote: Alicia Swan, PhD, an mTBI expert and director of rehabilitation research at the South Texas Veterans Health Care System within the Department of Veterans Affairs.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: Rocio Norman is a speech language pathologist who has worked with veterans for 18 years.
claims.quote: For Norman, a speech-language pathologist who has worked with veterans for 18 years
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: The study draws on recordings already collected at the San Antonio VA, in which veterans described how they were injured and an important life event.
claims.quote: The study builds on data from a targeted auditory plasticity study that Norman leads at the San Antonio VA, where researchers have already collected recordings in which veterans described how they were injured and recounted an important life event.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: The recordings were made at several points during treatment.
claims.quote: The recordings were collected at multiple points during treatment.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: After transcription, the team plans to assess features such as coherence, emotional tone, organization and level of detail.
claims.quote: allowing the team to assess features such as coherence, emotional tone, organization and level of detail.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: The researchers say the tool is meant to support clinicians and not replace them.
claims.quote: The researchers emphasize that the technology is intended to support clinicians, not replace them.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: Today detailed language analysis takes slow transcription and coding, often by several reviewers.
claims.quote: Detailed language analysis currently requires time-consuming transcription and coding, often by multiple reviewers.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: The immediate goal is to learn whether an automated method can objectively identify communication differences and how they relate to symptoms such as anxiety, post traumatic stress, depression and sleep difficulties.
claims.quote: the immediate goal is to determine whether an automated method can objectively identify communication differences and how those differences relate to neurobehavioral symptoms such as anxiety, post-traumatic stress, depression and sleep difficulties.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: If the pilot finds something meaningful, the team plans to seek larger federal grants.
claims.quote: If the pilot produces meaningful findings, the team plans to seek larger federal grants
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: Norman says the team hopes speech could become a biomarker for mild brain injury.
claims.quote: We use the term ‘biomarker’ because we hope speech could become a biomarker for mild TBI.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: The VA lists its Audie L. Murphy Memorial Veterans Hospital in San Antonio at ZIP code 78229.
claims.quote: San Antonio, TX 78229-4404
claims.document: VA South Texas health care, Audie L. Murphy Memorial Veterans Hospital

claims.text: Census Bureau records place ZIP Code Tabulation Area 78229 in Bexar County.
claims.document: US Census Bureau, 2020 ZCTA to county relationship file

claims.text: Many veterans Norman treated reported trouble finding words, organizing thoughts or keeping up in fast or noisy conversations, even when standard tests showed no clear impairment.
claims.quote: Many reported difficulty finding words, organizing their thoughts or keeping up in fast-moving or noisy conversations, even when standard assessments did not show a clear impairment.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: Norman says people with brain injury still have words and their grammar generally remains intact.
claims.quote: They still have words, and grammar generally remains intact
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: Norman says most adult language assessments were built for people with aphasia after a stroke or for severe brain injury.
claims.quote: Norman said most adult language assessments were developed for people with aphasia — a language disorder affecting communication — following a stroke or individuals with severe brain injury.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: An automated system could flag language features for a clinician to weigh alongside observations and standard assessments, and could save the clinician time.
claims.quote: An automated system could flag patterns for a clinician to consider alongside observations and standard assessments, while also saving valuable time for the clinician.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: Ta-Johnson says natural language processing offers a way to turn features of language into measurable data.
claims.quote: Natural language processing gives us a way to turn patterns in language into measurable data.
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

claims.text: The team hopes to make language analysis practical during a routine clinic visit.
claims.quote: with the intention of creating a tool that would make language analysis practical during a routine clinic visit
claims.document: UT Health San Antonio, Collaborative AI project seeks to improve care for veterans with mild brain injuries

rejected.reason: Not fetched. The grant is stated as the grantee institution reports it.

rejected.finding: Which VA building holds the recordings
rejected.reason: The article says only the San Antonio VA. No claim places the recordings at the Audie L. Murphy hospital or its ZIP code.
